title: Times Two
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Five short shoujo stories of first romance among high-school students: a Field Day crush, a soda can's expiration date taken as a sign, a delinquent who turns out to love gardening, a loud girl who can suddenly hear a model student's thoughts, and two childhood friends who once looked for UFOs together.
life_message: First love grows from seeing people as they really are and finding the courage to say how you feel.
